$comment: z-ai-web-dev-sdk: `const zai = await ZAI.create()` reads `baseUrl` and `apiKey` from a `.z-ai-config` JSON file (the working directory, the home directory or /etc) at run time, with no default: the host is `{zaiBaseUrl}`, and paths are under that base URL. Each method sends its argument as the JSON body (`fetch(`${baseUrl}/chat/completions`)`), the key as `Authorization: Bearer`; chat requests get `thinking: { type: "disabled" }` when the code gives none. `functions.invoke(name, args)` sends `{ function_name, arguments }`; `async.result.query(id)` puts the id in the query.
